svg.aria-label: Care is my building language. Writing code is becoming the easy part; deciding what to build, and why, is now the bottleneck. The time AI gives back, I spend on judgment: a clear spec before the build, a measure of whether it worked after, and the honesty to rethink the whole system when the numbers say it is wrong. The models are getting better quickly, which makes taste and care more valuable, not less. Nihan Bayrak. AI specialist, product manager, solutions engineer. Berlin. By day, WIN Creating Images.
svg.title: Care is my building language.
